system.description: Whenever an ally of equal or higher level than you is killed or reduced to 0 hit points within your line of sight, you gain a +2 Force bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of the encounter. (Since Force bonuses do not stack, you don't get a higher bonus if more than one ally falls in the same encounter.)

prerequisite.text: Dark Presence talent, and Power of the Dark Side talent

children.text: Power of the Dark Side talent
